title: CPPC supporting research data
description:
Supporting numerical data for the CPPC fluorescence image simulation project. The archive contains 22 Excel workbooks organized into five groups: manuscript figure and table data, optical benchmarks, real iSTORM sample R2 morphology statistics, R2 localization data, and a simulation sample.

The data complement the CPPC simulation code and retain the organization of the published GitHub data repository.
